integrity: All-size conclusions follow from a specified elementary free-face collapse and a graph homotopy reduction; finite verifier tests are corroboration only. Literature comparison does not establish global uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the ordinary independence complex of a complete bipartite graph with a specified cross-edge defect. The local collapse requires the defect leaf neighbor degree to be at least two. The forest classification does not extend without additional hypotheses to cyclic defect graphs; no equivariant or higher-independence claim is made.
title: Leaf-edge pruning of bipartite defects preserves independence-complex simple homotopy
